author: Cassie Abel
title: Ear-piercing studio to open in Stuyvesant Plaza - NewsBreak
text:
By Cassie Abel ,
13 hours ago
GUILDERLAND, N.Y. ( NEWS10 )– A women-founded ear-piercing studio, Rowan, is set to hold its grand opening on September 26 at 10 a.m. A special day designated to college students will be held on September 27.
Get the latest news, weather, sports and entertainment delivered right to your inbox! Rowan is a mom-founded and mom-led ear-piercing and hypoallergenic jewelry brand with studios across the U.S. The shop, which offers piercings performed by licensed nurses and is backed by a medical advisory board, aims to make ear-piercing as safe as possible starting at 2 months of age.
“We’re excited to bring our safe, celebratory ear piercing studio to the Stuyvesant Plaza – our first studio in the Capital Region,” said Louisa Serene Schneider, founder and CEO of Rowan. “Our studio is more than just a place to get pierced; it’s a sanctuary for self-expression and confidence. We believe in making every moment special.”
The Friday grand opening will include a giveaway for the first 50 customers and will have the opportunity to win a $50 gift card. On Saturday, college students with a student ID will receive a 15% discount on all non-piercing jewelry, with complimentary drinks available.
According to the business, a portion of its proceeds are donated to Next Gen Face, an organization whose mission is to help families of children with craniofacial conditions by assisting them in identifying a comprehensive and coordinated approach to treatment.
“We are thrilled to welcome Rowan, a nationally renowned, woman-founded business to Stuyvesant Plaza,” said Rachel Ferluge, General Manager of Stuyvesant Plaza. “For many families, ear piercings are a meaningful milestone, and Rowan makes the experience fun, not scary. With piercings performed exclusively by licensed nurses for the safest possible experience and a stylish, upbeat salon featuring hypoallergenic jewelry, Rowan is sure to create a memorable experience for our plaza guests as they celebrate these special moments.”
Rowan joins newly opened retailers including FP Movement , Anthropologie and Samantha Nass Floral Design.
